## Hi! I'm Sofia! 

:::: {layout-ncol=2}

:::{#first-column}



I recently graduated with a Masters of Environmental Data Science from the Bren School of Environmental Science & Management. Combining my previous work experience is in field biology, environmental policy, and marine conservation with my new found data analysis skills, I'm excited to tackle conservation and sustainability issues. I hope my career will lead to analyzing multifaceted environmental problems while combating environmental justice issues. My greatest interests are marine conservation, toxins reduction, and equitable environmental resources for all.
